ei.title: Culture Notes - Literature That Changed the Course of History

fullPassage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom living a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery. The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as property. After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it. This conflict led to the Civil War, which contributed to the end of slavery. Although Stowe's novel didn't get rid of slavery by itself, it played an important role in bringing about its end.

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom ①<u>living</u> a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, who ②<u>escape</u> from slavery. The novel ③<u>expose</u> the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as ④<u>property</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 소설은 주로 노예로서 힘든 삶을 사는 톰 아저씨를 따라간다. 소설은 노예 제도의 공포를 폭로한다.
det.analysis: ③ expose → exposes: 주어 'The novel'은 3인칭 단수이므로 동사에 -s를 붙여야 함. ① living: 현재분사로 Uncle Tom을 수식(적절). ② escape: 관계대명사 who의 선행사가 Eliza and her son(복수)이므로 escape(적절). ④ property: 명사로 as의 보어(적절).
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어(The novel) + 현재시제 → 동사에 -s 필수.

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom living a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, ①<u>who</u> escape from slavery. The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and ②<u>treating</u> humans as property. After it was ③<u>publishing</u>, people in the North became ④<u>increasingly</u> against slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 소설이 출판된 후 북부 사람들은 점점 더 노예 제도에 반대하게 되었다.
det.analysis: ③ publishing → published: 'it was published'에서 소설은 출판'되는' 대상이므로 수동태(과거분사). publishing(능동)은 부적절. ① who: Eliza and her son을 선행사로 하는 관계대명사(적절). ② treating: 'the slavery system and treating humans'에서 동명사(적절). ④ increasingly: 부사로 against를 수식(적절).
det.tip: be + 과거분사 = 수동태. publish → was published(출판되다).

questions.passage: After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted ①<u>to keep</u> it. This conflict led to the Civil War, ②<u>which</u> contributed to the end of slavery. Although Stowe's novel didn't get rid of slavery by ③<u>herself</u>, it played an important role in ④<u>bringing</u> about its end.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 스토의 소설이 그 자체로는 노예 제도를 없애지 못했지만, 종식을 가져오는 데 중요한 역할을 했다.
det.analysis: ③ herself → itself: 주어가 'Stowe's novel'(사물)이므로 재귀대명사는 itself. herself는 여성 사람을 가리킴. ① to keep: want + to부정사(적절). ② which: 콤마 뒤 계속적 용법의 관계대명사(적절). ④ bringing: in + 동명사(적절).
det.tip: 재귀대명사는 주어의 인칭·수·성과 일치해야 한다. novel(사물) → itself.

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin ①<u>contributed</u> to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom ②<u>lived</u> a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery. The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as ③<u>property</u>. After it was published, people in the North became ④<u>increasingly</u> against slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 소설은 주로 노예로서 힘든 삶을 사는 톰 아저씨를 따라간다.
det.analysis: ② lived → living: 'follows Uncle Tom living a hard life'에서 현재분사 living이 목적격 보어로 사용. follows + 목적어 + 현재분사(~하는 것을 따라가다). lived(과거분사)는 부적절. ① contributed: 과거시제(적절). ③ property: 명사(적절). ④ increasingly: 부사(적절).
det.tip: follow + O + 현재분사: ~가 ...하는 것을 따라가다. living은 동시 진행 동작.

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. questions.stem: 다음 글에서 'treating humans as property'의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 인간을 재능 있는 존재로 여기는 것

det.korean: 소설은 노예 제도의 공포와 인간을 재산으로 취급하는 것을 폭로한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: treating(취급하는 것) + humans(인간을) + as property(재산으로). 노예를 물건처럼 취급하는 것을 의미.
det.tip: treat A as B: A를 B로 취급하다. property: 재산, 소유물.

questions.passage: After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it. This conflict led to the Civil War, which contributed to the end of slavery.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 'get rid of'와 의미가 가장 비슷한 것은?

det.korean: 스토의 소설이 그 자체로는 노예 제도를 없애지 못했다.
det.analysis: ✅ eliminate: '제거하다'로 get rid of와 유의어. maintain(유지하다)는 반의어. discover(발견하다), promote(촉진하다)는 불일치.
det.tip: get rid of = eliminate = remove: 없애다, 제거하다.

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom living a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery.

det.korean: 톰 아저씨는 노예로서 힘든(hard) 삶을 살았다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문에 'living a hard life'라고 명시. 편안한 삶이 아니라 힘든 삶.
det.tip: hard life(힘든 삶) ≠ 편안한 삶. 노예의 삶을 묘사하는 문맥.

questions.passage: After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. However, because the Southern economy relied on slave labor, people in the South still wanted to keep it. This conflict led to the Civil War, which contributed to the end of slavery.
questions.stem: 소설 출판 후 남부와 북부 사람들 모두 노예 제도에 반대하게 되었다.

det.korean: 북부는 반대했지만 남부는 유지하고 싶어했다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문에 북부는 'increasingly against slavery'이지만, 남부는 'still wanted to keep it'이라고 명시. 모두 반대한 것이 아님.
det.tip: 북부(against) vs 남부(wanted to keep) — 상반된 입장.

questions.passage: This conflict led to the Civil War, which contributed to the end of slavery. Although Stowe's novel didn't get rid of slavery by itself, it played an important role in bringing about its end.

det.korean: 소설이 그 자체로는 노예 제도를 없애지 못했지만 종식에 중요한 역할을 했다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: 원문에 'didn't get rid of slavery by itself'라고 명시. 단독으로 폐지한 것이 아니라 중요한 역할을 했을 뿐.
det.tip: by itself: 그 자체만으로, 단독으로. didn't ~ by itself = 혼자 힘으로는 ~하지 못했다.

det.tip: treating humans as property: 인간을 재산으로 취급하다. 노예 제도의 본질을 드러내는 표현.

questions.passage: The novel exposes the horrors of the slavery system and treating humans as property. After it was published, people in the North became increasingly against slavery. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 __________이 남북 전쟁으로 이어졌다.
det.analysis: ✅ conflict(갈등): 북부(반대)와 남부(유지)의 상반된 입장 → 갈등 → 전쟁. agreement(합의), compromise(타협), cooperation(협력)은 대립 문맥과 반대.
det.tip: 북부 vs 남부의 대립 → conflict(갈등) → Civil War(남북전쟁).

questions.passage: Harriet Beecher Stowe's 1852 novel Uncle Tom's Cabin contributed to historical change in the United States. The novel mainly follows Uncle Tom living a hard life as an African American slave. It also features Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery.

ch: 엘라이자와 그녀의 아들은 노예 신분에서 탈출한다.

det.korean: 엘라이자와 아들이 노예 신분에서 탈출한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④: 원문에 'Eliza and her son, who escape from slavery'로 일치. ① 1852년(1862년 아님). ② African American(유럽계 아님). ③ 혼자가 아니라 아들과 함께.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 스토의 소설이 노예 제도 폐지에 중요한 역할을 했다는 내용.

det.korean: 스토의 소설이 그 자체로는 노예 제도를 없애지 못했지만, 종식을 가져오는 데 중요한 역할을 했다.
det.analysis: 핵심 표현: although(비록 ~이지만), get rid of(없애다), by itself(그 자체로), play a role in(~에 역할을 하다), bring about(~을 초래하다).
det.tip: get rid of: 없애다. play an important role in + -ing: ~하는 데 중요한 역할을 하다. bring about: 초래하다.
